author: Zetetic I
title: Deeper 1D CNN with Residual Connection
abstract: Building on the success of the simple 1D CNN (ID 571), this submission explores a deeper architecture. The model now uses two stacked 1D convolutional blocks to learn more complex, hierarchical features from the RNA sequences. A residual connection is added to the second block to improve gradient flow and stabilize training. The hypothesis is that this deeper model will capture more intricate patterns and further improve performance across the seven datasets.
